import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "key" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "value" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const arInternalMetadata = defineTable("ar_internal_metadata", {
    columns: {
        key: col.text().primaryKey(),
        value: col.text(),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        updatedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull()
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
